findings.title: Royalty patch comment still names the old mode label
findings.detail: The comment added in this build says "a player pawn set to \"Autocast, may move\"", but this same build renames AAI_Mode_Full to "Full Autocast" and updates every tooltip to match. Change the comment text to "Full Autocast" so the only remaining mention of the old label agrees with the UI.

findings.title: Tooltip hint is not gated by the new ShowMarker setting
findings.detail: Patch_Command_AutocastHint.Postfix appends the "Right-click to set autocast" line whenever Offers is true, regardless of AbilityAISettings.ShowMarker. The setting's tooltip only promises to control the ring, so this is consistent, but a player who turns the marker off to declutter still gets the extra tooltip text. If that is not intended, add `!AbilityAISettings.ShowMarker ||` handling at the top of the postfix.
